source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Analog-style drum machine (bass drum, snare, toms, rim shot, clap, hi-hats, crash and ride) with per-voice level, tune and decay, and shuffle.
use_for: Complete synthesised drum machine with kick, snare, toms, rim, clap, hats, crash and ride.
quirks: It plays from trigger columns, not notes: each track has BD Trigger … RC Trigger switches (a 1 hits that drum). notes_write can't play it, and param_set can't set the triggers; songs that use it carry their own patterns.
Silent at its defaults until a trigger fires (profile).
Tune and decay are bare 0–63 scales; levels go to about 200%.
Closed source: names and units come from its own descriptions and texts; the trigger columns from the repo songs' saved parameter tables.
Neo Drums is its successor: machine_replace carries the eleven drums over (see the page).
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/Oomek/Exciter/test.bmx — a repo song using it (six do); its saved parameter table lists the 11 trigger columns

parameters.name: BD Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the bass drum, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the bass drum, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A lower value is a deeper thud, a higher one a tighter, higher kick.

parameters.name: BD Attack
parameters.description: Click of the bass drum's attack, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the click at the start of the bass drum, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A higher value gives a harder, clicking beater; lower is rounder.

parameters.name: BD Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the bass drum, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the bass drum, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A higher value rings longer; lower is a short punch.

parameters.name: SD Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the snare, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the snare, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Raises or lowers the snare's body tone.

parameters.name: SD Tone
parameters.description: Tone of the snare, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the tone of the snare, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Moves the snare between a darker and a brighter character.

parameters.name: SD Snap
parameters.description: Snappy noise of the snare, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the amount of snappy noise in the snare, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A higher value adds more rattle and bite; lower is a duller drum.

parameters.name: LT Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the low tom, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the low tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Raises or lowers the low tom.

parameters.name: LT Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the low tom, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the low tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Longer values ring out; shorter are dry thumps.

parameters.name: MT Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the mid tom, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the mid tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Raises or lowers the mid tom.

parameters.name: MT Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the mid tom, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the mid tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Longer values ring out; shorter are dry thumps.

parameters.name: HT Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the high tom, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the high tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Raises or lowers the high tom.

parameters.name: HT Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the high tom, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the high tom, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Longer values ring out; shorter are dry thumps.

parameters.name: CH Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the closed hi-hat, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the closed hi-hat, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A higher value lets the closed hat ring longer; lower is a tight tick.

parameters.name: OH Decay
parameters.description: Decay of the open hi-hat, 0–63.
parameters.how: Sets the decay of the open hi-hat, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: A higher value is a longer open hat; lower chokes it short.

parameters.name: CC Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the crash cymbal, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the crash cymbal, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Shifts the crash brighter or darker.

parameters.name: RC Tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the ride cymbal, 0–63 (no unit in its texts).
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the ride cymbal, 0 to 63 (32 by default; the machine's texts give no unit).
parameters.sound: Shifts the ride brighter or darker.

parameters.name: Shuffle
parameters.description: Delays every other step, 0 to 0.5 tick (about 0.25 tick at raw 128), as its texts read.
parameters.how: Delays every other step by 0 to 0.5 tick (about 0.25 tick at raw 128); 0 is off, the default.
parameters.sound: A little delay gives the pattern a swung, shuffled feel; none leaves it straight.

parameters.name: Shuffle Step
parameters.description: Which steps the shuffle delays, 2–32.
parameters.how: Chooses which steps the shuffle delays, from every 2nd to every 32nd step, 2 by default.
parameters.sound: Wider spacing swings only some of the steps, so the shuffle is felt over longer groups.
